packed_codecs.layout: One complete AV1 temporal unit in low-overhead OBU format whose decoded chroma format is 4:4:4, beginning with a temporal delimiter. Sequence headers are carried in-band when FRAME_CODEC_CONFIG is set; random-access frames set FRAME_KEYFRAME. This codec ID is never negotiated as the 4:2:0 MEDIA_CODEC_AV1 codec.

packed_codecs.layout: One complete AV1 temporal unit in low-overhead OBU format, beginning with a temporal delimiter. Sequence headers are carried in-band when FRAME_CODEC_CONFIG is set; random-access frames set FRAME_KEYFRAME.

packed_codecs.layout: One complete H.264 Annex-B access unit whose decoded chroma format is 4:4:4. SPS/PPS and other decoder configuration are carried in-band when FRAME_CODEC_CONFIG is set; key access units set FRAME_KEYFRAME. This codec ID is never negotiated as the 4:2:0 MEDIA_CODEC_H264 codec.
packed_codecs.name: media-h264-444-v1

packed_codecs.layout: One complete H.264 Annex-B access unit. SPS/PPS and other decoder configuration are carried in-band when FRAME_CODEC_CONFIG is set; key access units set FRAME_KEYFRAME.
packed_codecs.name: media-h264-v1

packed_codecs.layout: One complete JPEG interchange datastream from SOI through EOI. Every frame is independently decodable and sets FRAME_KEYFRAME.
packed_codecs.name: media-mjpeg-v1

packed_codecs.layout: packet_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated packet_len:u16,packet:packet_len. Packets are complete Opus packets in decode order, nonempty, and together cover one Media FRAME duration; sample rate on the wire is 48000.

packed_codecs.layout: Interleaved IEEE-754 binary32 little-endian samples in MediaFormat channel order; finite values are in [-1,1], negative zero is canonicalized to positive zero, and payload length is a nonzero multiple of channels*4. One FRAME payload contains complete sample frames and no codec-local header.
packed_codecs.name: media-pcm-f32le-v1

packed_codecs.layout: Interleaved signed 16-bit little-endian samples in MediaFormat channel order; payload length is a nonzero multiple of channels*2. One FRAME payload contains complete sample frames and no codec-local header.
packed_codecs.name: media-pcm-s16le-v1

packed_codecs.layout: One complete VP9 frame in unframed elementary-stream form. Decoder configuration is derived from key frames; superframes are permitted only when their index and every contained frame fit the negotiated complete_len.

packed_codecs.layout: metadata_count:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,repeated tag:u16,flags:u16,len:u32,body:len; access_unit:remaining. Metadata is unique and tag-ordered. packed_codecs.layout: metadata_count:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,repeated tag:u16,flags:u16,len:u32,body:len; png_datastream:remaining. Metadata is unique and tag-ordered.
